Team —

Quick heads-up and ask: we have a strong candidate (Sam Park) whose onsite loop is set for Monday 2026-11-16, 10:00–12:30 PST. Two of the original panelists just pinged OOO, so we need short-notice coverage for three core slots: system design (45m), reliability/ops (45m), performance/debugging (30m). The candidate is senior IC-level; we want at least one infra-senior and one platform reliability voice.

Attach: interview_slate_SamPark.pdf (PDF) + availability_sheet_v2.xlsx (xlsx). I also uploaded a quick infra_experts_list.csv with names we can ask (short list).

Asks:
- Can each of you confirm which slot you can cover by EOD today?
- If you can’t cover, please add names of people you can borrow from your teams (we're using a temporary "on-call lending" pattern: 90m of pooled coverage divided across volunteers)
- If you commit, please add the slot to your calendar with the event title: "REDWOOD Interview: Sam Park — [role]" and tag with #interview-panel so Recruiting can track.

I know this is short notice — I’ll coordinate conflicts and backfills once I get replies.

Thanks,
Marcus

All —

I can take the performance/debugging slot 11:35–12:05. I’ll split the time in the calendar as requested. Two quick process notes I recommend we adopt for short-notice fills to keep load balanced:

1) Micro-lending window: donors cover a single 45m or 30m slot and then are off the hook for the rest of the day (so we don't overload a single person).
2) Backup assignment: whoever volunteers should also add a named backup (peer) on the invite in case of ping/incident.

If we need an extra panelist for calibration, I can ping a couple people in my rotation and ask them to be on standby. I attached infra_experts_list.csv with a few folks flagged as "can do short notice".

Jordan
